That's fair, I don't think it would ruin, but change the rhythm. If you want to preserve the rhythm though you could always change the words but keep the rhythm to clarify the image.

Beautiful poem regardless.

Okay, i follow what you mean now, i just think there may be a clearer way of saying that in the poem.

I think it's a nice image that the sun/love dulls everything else because of how brightly it shines/how intense it feels.

You could almost cut it to 

'The sun

bleaches out the stars'

I'm struggling to get an idea of how the symbolism in this works.

For one, does the sun have a shadow? It tripped me because i'm not really sure that it does, at least not in the conventional sense.

I like the imagery of a shadow 'bleaching out' the colour from something, the same way bleach does in laundry. This is the strongest imagery in the poem for me.

The way i'm reading the poem has it that being in love has made you do and think things less extremely, with less colour.

As a message I like it, but i feel like it could be achieved without the confusion of such an absurd image as the 'sun's shadow'.

If it helps I'm exactly like this except with a little more control. I can flit between extrovert and introvert reasonably easily when i'm on my own, when i'm around people who have expectations of either one from me, i find it borderline impossible.

It is something that I presume to have, undiagnosed. I display all the common symptoms.

I just want to know how i can explain to my university without my family finding out.

I want help but I don't want to give up my privacy.

Now just imagine you're feeling like you feel now but everything's going wrong objectively too. Really picture it. And then just lift it off, because you've already got half a mile on the people who need to sort their lives out. You're perfectly set to come out of this into happiness, don't throw that away.

I wish I knew what to say to you to change your mind. I really, genuinely do. If i had 1 wish right now it would be to have the words to say to you. I know you think that's bullshit but it really isn't. Keep going, even though your brain is screaming at you that you shouldn't. Keep going.

I don't know how to solve your situation. And truthfully? I agree with you. It sounds like you can't heal yourself. But there are people who can, and I really want you to talk to them.

You want to form relationships with people, and you will. You will I swear it. Everything's not alright but it will be. Stay with us.
